texts.name: Vulpiks
texts.biography: Vulpiks was a cunning fox-folk sorcerer who bargained with ancient blood spirits for power over the elements. By weaving pure elemental essence with the crimson ichor of the fallen, he learned to reshape Air and Fire Elementals into relentless Blood Wraiths that answer only to his will. His Bloody Necromancy does not raise mere skeletons — The fire itself responds to its call..

specialty.tooltip: Upgrades Air & Fire Elementals to Blood Wraiths. Bloody Necromancy raises Air Elementals.
specialty.name: Blood and Element
